name: ada
description: A coding agent built on Flue 2.0, exposed as AG-UI events over SSE and over Slack/web chat.

comments.runtime: Node >=23 runs the .ts sources natively (type stripping), so `npm start` needs no build step. `vite build` produces the optimized Flue Node server for the image.
comments.@earendil-works/pi-ai: Flue's model layer. Imported DIRECTLY (not just transitively) because agent/config/model.ts builds a custom provider for the Astro AI Gateway with createProvider().
comments.@ag-ui/core: PINNED reference for validating emitted AG-UI events against the canonical Zod schemas in CI. Local types in agent/types/agui.ts mirror it.
comments.@opentelemetry/api: Optional at runtime — telemetry degrades to no-op if absent. The OTLP SDK/exporter is provided out-of-process by the astropods telemetry adapter.
